title: Blockchain Explained in 5 Minutes | Solana vs Ethereum
description:
What is a blockchain, and why do networks like Solana and Ethereum work so differently?

In this video, I break down blockchain from first principles using simple analogies and beginner-friendly explanations.

🚀 Want to learn Solana from zero to advanced? Start here: https://www.learnsol.site

We’ll cover how blockchains order transactions, why Ethereum processes transactions sequentially, and how Solana uses Proof of History and parallel execution to scale faster.

Topics covered:

• What is a blockchain?
• Ethereum vs Solana
• Proof of History explained
• Why Solana is faster
• Blockchain scalability basics

📚 Learn Solana in depth: https://www.learnsol.site
💻 Built for developers, students, and Web3 builders

#blockchain #solana #ethereum #web3 #rustlang
